scripts.db:start: mkdir -p data/db && (lsof -t -iTCP:27017 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null && echo 'MongoDB already running on 27017' || (nohup .mongodb/mongodb-macos-aarch64--8.2.1/bin/mongod --dbpath data/db --bind_ip 127.0.0.1 --port 27017 --logpath data/mongod.log >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo 'MongoDB started (backend/data)'))
scripts.db:stop: kill $(lsof -t -iTCP:27017 -sTCP:LISTEN) 2>/dev/null && echo 'MongoDB stopped' || echo 'MongoDB was not running'
